resources.string: Connect to your Apple Watch / iPhone
Hold Apple Watch or iPhone near the reader to connect.
And if AirPods Pro 3 or a 3rd party Heart Rate Sensor is paired with your iPhone you will get heart rate data synced with your workout.
Hold your Apple Watch or iPhone near the reader and tap to confirm the connection on your device to automatically connect to this machine.
Hold your Apple Watch or iPhone near the reader to the top right and tap to confirm the connection on your device to automatically connect to this machine.
Hold your Apple Watch or iPhone near the reader to the bottom left and tap to confirm the connection on your device to automatically connect to this machine.
Hold your Apple Watch or iPhone near the reader to the bottom center and tap to confirm the connection on your device to automatically connect to this machine.
